name: Dust cloud
summary: Low brown dust cloud kicked up along the ground with flying pebbles; for skids, stomps and landings.

params.name: x
params.note: impact point x on the ground

params.name: y
params.note: ground line y at the impact

params.name: width
params.note: how wide the cloud spreads in px

params.name: at
params.note: start as a fraction of the shot (0..1)

params.name: atFrame
params.note: start frame inside the shot; overrides at
